entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: Largest city of the Fallaji Empire, in the Great Desert of Terisiare, and capital of the tribe of the same name.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Desert empire of Terisiare whose largest city was Tomakul.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Boy of the Suwwardi who united the Fallaji tribes.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Entered Tomakul with Hajar after the Fallaji tribes were united under Qadir.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Entered Tomakul with Mishra and found it beautiful and corrupt.

events.summary: Mishra and Hajar enter Tomakul after the Fallaji tribes are united under the boy Qadir.
events.quote: After uniting the Fallaji tribes under the boy Qadir of the Suwwardi , Mishra and Hajar entered Tomakul.

relations.note: Tomakul was the largest settlement of the Fallaji Empire.
relations.quote: The city of Tomakul was the largest settlement of the Fallaji Empire
